label: TEST FIXTURE — not a real community submission or completed intervention
problemStatement: Communities in pilot states report difficulty understanding how state budget allocations for primary healthcare relate to actual facility-level service availability.

geography.note: Illustrative only; not a prevalence claim.

supportingEvidence.note: Electoral coverage is separate; included only to demonstrate cross-link pattern.
Health expenditure is not facility functionality.

evidenceLimitations: Budget allocation is not release, expenditure, or facility functionality.
No claim that any specific PHC is non-functional.
This is a test fixture for workflow wiring only.

responsibleInstitution.name: State Primary Health Care Development Agency / State Ministry of Health (varies by state)
responsibleInstitution.duty: Primary healthcare delivery and facility oversight within state mandate

governmentResponsibility: Publish and implement facility-level service and expenditure information consistent with legal duties.
iseycResponsibility: Clarify public demand after human review; attach evidence with limitations; support budget and health literacy — not deliver clinical services.
partnerResponsibility: Qualified health partners for any clinical or facility assessment.
communityParticipation: Submit clarified observations; participate in literacy sessions if offered.
proposedIntervention: Civic prepares a draft public demand for clearer facility-level reporting after specialist Health review of evidence limits; Education may support a budget-literacy module.
requiredExpertiseAndResources: Human reviewer (Civic); Health evidence review; optional Education curriculum support.
expectedOutputs: Draft mandate text (unpublished until human approval)
expectedOutcomes: Clearer public understanding of the distinction between expenditure figures and service availability
verificationMethod: Publication decision log; any literacy session pre/post competency check — not national prevalence.
